name: Lotus Health Group Company
summary: Lotus Health Group Company, formerly known as Lotus Health Industry Holding Group Company, operates within China as a manufacturer and supplier of healthy food items and condiments. Its product range encompasses seasoning agents like monosodium glutamate (MSG) and chicken bouillon, various starches (including potato and corn-based varieties), and a selection of healthy oils, energy beverages, and nutritious snacks. The company also provides essential pantry staples such as flour, rice, and pasta. Established in 1983, Lotus Health Group maintains its headquarters in Xiangcheng, China.
